description: This file defines a JPEG transcoder with error handling, capable of re-encoding images to JPEG format with size and quality constraints. It includes error enums, a struct with static methods for quality clamping and image transcoding, and handles image properties, orientation, and size adjustments.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: An enum representing possible errors during JPEG transcoding, including decode failure, missing properties, encode failure, and size limit exceeded.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A struct providing static methods for clamping quality and transcoding images to JPEG with size and quality constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps a quality value between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Re-encodes image data to JPEG format, optionally downscaling to fit within maxWidthPx and maxBytes constraints, normalizing orientation, and adjusting quality.
